content.en: Algorithms play a crucial role in various aspects of drug development and decision making. They are used to implement non-linear mixed effects modeling, model-based drug development, Bayesian methods, benefit-risk assessment, meta-analysis, exposure-response analysis, likelihood ratio test methods, pharmacogenomics and pharmacometrics integration, statistics and pharmacometrics synergy, model-informed drug development, mechanistic in silico models evaluation, quantitative systems pharmacology assessment, innovative technology utilization, real-world data assessment, systems models predictive capability evaluation, pediatric drug development support, real-world evidence utilization, model-based meta-analysis, real-world data practices and challenges, and statistical considerations for using real-world data in regulatory decision making. These algorithms help researchers and regulators make informed decisions, accelerate drug development, and improve patient outcomes.
content.da: Algoritmer spiller en afgørende rolle i forskellige aspekter af lægemiddeludvikling og beslutningstagning. De bruges til at implementere non-lineær mixed effects modeling, model-based drug development, Bayesian methods, benefit-risk assessment, meta-analyse, exposure-response analysis, likelihood ratio test methods, pharmacogenomics and pharmacometrics integration, statistics and pharmacometrics synergy, model-informed drug development, mechanistic in silico models evaluation, quantitative systems pharmacology assessment, innovative technology utilization, real-world data assessment, systems models predictive capability evaluation, pediatric drug development support, real-world evidence utilization, model-based meta-analysis, real-world data practices and challenges, og statistiske overvejelser ved brug af real-world data i regulatorisk beslutningstagning. Disse algoritmer hjælper forskere og regulatorer med at træffe informerede beslutninger, accelerere lægemiddeludvikling og forbedre patientresultater.

critic.en: All these algorithms, integrated into the already Byzantine processes of drug development and regulation, create a situation in which what was already a major problem -- allowing potentially toxic drugs to reach the market -- becomes an even more acute problem with the potential to cause direct harm to patients.
critic.da: Forestil dig en verden, hvor algoritmer styrer beslutningerne om, hvilke medicin der skal udvikles, og hvem der skal have dem. Skal vi virkelig overlade så afgørende processer til teknologier, der er designet til at forbedre effektiviteten, men som samtidig kan sløre de etiske og menneskelige udfordringer, der ligger i medicin og sundhed? Behandlinger og patienters liv er ikke bare data og modeller. De er komplekse og dynamiske processer, der kræver empati, omtanke og etisk overvejelse.

potential.en: I agree that algorithms are crucial in drug development! They enable researchers to analyze complex data, assess risks and benefits, and make more informed decisions. By leveraging technologies such as AI and machine learning, we can expedite the process of bringing new drugs to market and ensure that they are safe and effective. I'm excited to see how these advancements will revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes in the future!
potential.da: Det er imponerende at se, hvor omfattende og alsidig brugen af algoritmer er i lægemiddeludvikling. Det viser virkelig potentialet for teknologi til at transformere sundhedssektoren. Algoritmerne kan ikke blot accelerere processen, men også styrke kvaliteten af de beslutninger, der træffes - både for forskere og regulatorer. Det er en klar opfordring til fortsat investering i og udforskning af den digitale udvikling!
